citation: Glazko et al. (2024) on disability bias in GPT-4 resume ranking; Webster (2025) on intersectional auditing; Wilson & Caliskan (2024).
caveat: Because the contrast is against an unmarked neutral organisation, these estimates are not symmetric group differences and must not be read as such.

citation: Neumark, Burn & Button (2019), 'Is it harder for older workers to find jobs?', Journal of Political Economy 127(2) — the graduation-year design for age audits.
caveat: Apparent age cannot be varied without touching career length: an earlier graduation year implies a longer career even when the listed roles are identical. The matched EARLY_CAREER_NOTE narrows the gap but does not close it, so an age effect here is an upper bound that partly reflects seniority expectations. Reported separately from the clean protected families.
